record.name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
record.one_liner: Adobe Commerce provides developers with software, tools, and services to customize and extend Adobe Commerce via out-of-process App Builder applications, webhooks, REST, and GraphQL endpoints.

auth.notes: Adobe Identity Management Service (IMS) manages authentication for App Builder apps and API communications.

api_surface.notes: Adobe Commerce exposes REST endpoints, GraphQL (via API Mesh), webhooks, and out-of-process SDKs.

evidence.claim: Adobe Commerce provides APIs and extensibility tools for developers.
evidence.quote: Adobe provides developers with software, tools, and services to customize and extend Adobe Commerce to support multichannel, global commerce for B2B and B2C, and integrate with backend systems.

evidence.claim: Applications communicate with Commerce using supported APIs, events, webhooks, and extension points.
evidence.quote: These applications communicate with Commerce using supported APIs, events, webhooks, and extension points rather than adding PHP code directly to the Commerce codebase.

evidence.claim: Adobe Commerce supports webhooks that execute calls to external systems when events trigger.
evidence.quote: Webhooks enable developers to configure synchronous logic to execute calls to external systems when an Adobe Commerce event triggers.

evidence.claim: Adobe Identity Management Service (IMS) manages authentication.
evidence.quote: Adobe Identity Management Service (IMS) manages authentication.

evidence.claim: API Mesh allows developers to combine multiple data sources into a single, queryable GraphQL endpoint.
evidence.quote: API Mesh allows developers to combine multiple data sources into a single, queryable GraphQL endpoint.
